product_metadata.title: Williams-Sonoma Kitchen Towels (Sage)
features: Set of four, one of each design
description: Williams-Sonoma has updated their popular towel set with fresh patterns and an array of vibrant hues. Loomed from yarn-dyed Turkish cotton, the set features pinstripes, wide stripes, windowpane plaid and their signature logo design, all in a high-density twill weave with superior absorbency and a smooth touch. Laundering and use only improve them, so you can count on them for years of exceptional service.
